_comment: The 10 demonic pact potions (GDD 5.3). cost = run-permanent stat loss (D13/D17); durations per D14; flat numbers are level-30 values scaled by hero level (D15).

colossus.name: Colossus Draught
colossus.description: +100 Stamina (at level 30) and 30% larger for 1 minute.

butcher.name: Butcher's Distillate
butcher.description: +80 Strength (at level 30) and +15% Leech for 1 minute.

void_eye.name: Void-Eye Tincture
void_eye.description: Every attack and spell is a critical strike for 45 seconds.

astral.name: Astral Nectar
astral.description: Spells cost no mana and +75 Spell Power (at level 30) for 1 minute.

phantasmal.name: Phantasmal Phial
phantasmal.description: Dodge every physical attack for 30 seconds.

hellfire.name: Hellfire Ichor
hellfire.description: +100% Haste and +50% Movement Speed for 1 minute.

serum.name: Serum of Damnation
serum.description: Your health can't drop below 1 for 20 seconds.

magma.name: Liquid Magma Flask
magma.description: A flame aura burns nearby foes for 150 fire damage per second (at level 30) for 1 minute.

leech_oil.name: Unholy Leech Oil
leech_oil.description: 20% of all damage the party deals heals you for 1 minute.

thorns.name: Barrow Thorns Brew
thorns.description: Reflect 300% of melee damage taken as true damage for 1 minute.
